original.statement: A new stable API version v1 is now served for the ImageUpdateAutomation custom resource kind.

decision.reason: The validators confirm, from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], that image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 ImageUpdateAutomation exists only in the target release. They also confirm the consequence is "none". Because the change only adds something, no environment can already use v1, and nothing fails anywhere. The proposed exposure, gvk-in-use for ImageUpdateAutomation with no version given, only marks environments that use this kind as the audience for an informational notice, so it creates no mandatory work. The excerpts themselves are minimal and no canonical exposure exists for an added API version, so my confidence is low.
